info.title: rssam API
info.description:
REST API of the rssam RSS aggregator.

**Authentication.** Every `/v1` endpoint takes `X-Auth-Token: <token>` where the token is either a personal API key (`POST /v1/me/api-keys`) or the global `AUTH_TOKEN` (maps to user id 1). A browser session cookie is also accepted, but state-changing requests authenticated only by the cookie must pass the same-origin check (`Sec-Fetch-Site`/`Origin`), otherwise 403.

**Envelope.** Successful JSON responses are `{"data": ..., "total": n}`; errors are `{"error_message": "..."}`. Lists take `limit`/`offset`; `total` is the full row count.

**Ownership.** Objects are scoped to the calling user; reading another user's object yields 404. Endpoints marked "Requires an admin principal" return 403 for non-admins.

**Request id.** Every response carries `X-Request-Id` (echoed from the request when a proxy set it, generated otherwise); quote it when reporting 5xx errors.

**Limits.** Request bodies are capped (MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES, default 1 MiB) → 413; per-IP rate limits on authentication failures and sensitive routes → 429.

get.description: Pings the database with a 2 s timeout. Unauthenticated.

503.description: Database not configured or ping failed.

get.description: Authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer <METRICS_TOKEN>`, not with the API token.

403.description: Metrics disabled (no METRICS_TOKEN) or bad bearer token.

put.summary: Mark all entries of a category as read

post.description: feed_url is validated against the SSRF policy (no private networks unless FETCH_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK). Requires an admin principal.
Body is either raw OPML or a multipart form with a `file` field. Existing feed URLs are skipped; categories are created on demand (MAX_IMPORT_FEEDS caps the total). Requires an admin principal.

parameters.name: async
parameters.description: Run in the background and return a job id.

413.description: OPML larger than the request body limit.

200.description: Aggregate result. When a background scheduler is configured feeds are queued; otherwise they are refreshed inline.

409.description: Another feed already uses this URL.

put.summary: Mark all entries of a feed as read

200.description: Icon, base64 in JSON (cached per feed).

404.description: Feed not found or the site has no icon.

200.description: Entries across all feeds of the caller.

get.description: Downloads the entry URL (SSRF-guarded), applies the feed's scraper rules or the readability extractor, and stores the result.

200.description: Entry with content replaced by the extracted article; original kept in original_content.

502.description: The article page could not be fetched or parsed.

200.description: Filters with rules, scope and actions.

post.description: Rules are validated (field, RE2 pattern) and actions must be one of label/webhook/delete. Requires an admin principal.

put.description: rules/scope_items/actions, when present, replace the existing sets. Requires an admin principal.

200.description: Match result for the sample and, with limit, per stored entry.
Matches, newest first, with the matched entry embedded.

post.description: url is SSRF-checked for kind=http. telegram/max kinds take their provider block instead. Requires an admin principal.
Uses the newest matching entry (or a synthetic sample) and the webhook's template. Requires an admin principal.

502.description: Delivery failed; body carries the same result object with ok=false.

200.description: Marked pending; the webhook worker picks it up.

post.description: Bootstrap exception: while no login-capable user exists and ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD are configured, this endpoint accepts an unauthenticated request. Requires an admin principal.

400.description: Invalid id, or the caller tried to delete their own account.

409.description: Refused: this is the last admin.

201.description: Key with the plaintext token, shown once.

get.description: Authenticate with X-Auth-Token (or `?token=` is NOT supported - use the header or the session cookie). Server events: entry.created, feed.refreshed, webhook.delivered and others; inbound frames above 4 KiB close the connection.

101.description: Switching Protocols. Frames are JSON: {"event":..., "data":...}; the first frame is `subscribed` with the channel list. Client → server: {"action":"subscribe","channels":["all","feed:<id>"]} and {"action":"pong"}.

AuthToken.name: X-Auth-Token
AuthToken.description: Personal API key or the global AUTH_TOKEN.

SessionCookie.name: session_id
SessionCookie.description: Web UI session. Mutations additionally require a same-origin request.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Page size; values above 10000 are clamped.

entrySearch.name: q
entrySearch.description: Full-text search over title and content.

Forbidden.description: Admin required, or a cookie-authenticated request that failed the same-origin check.

NotFound.description: Object not found or not owned by the caller.

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error. The response carries an X-Request-Id header to correlate with server logs.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The backing store for this resource is not configured.

BadGateway.description: Upstream (feed, site or webhook endpoint) failed.

Error.description: Error envelope returned by every non-2xx JSON response.

feed_type.description: Detected feed format (rss, atom, json, ...); omitted when unknown.

interval_minutes.description: Refresh interval; 0 = use the global default.
Refresh interval; 0 = use the global default.

FeedWrite.description: Full representation on PUT: omitted fields are reset to their zero value.

original_content.description: Feed content kept when full content was fetched.

EntryUpdate.description: At least one field must be present.

EntriesBulkUpdate.description: entry_ids: 1..1000 ids owned by the caller. Set status and/or starred.

FilterOp.description: Boolean operator joining this rule with the next one; empty means and.

FilterScopeItemWrite.description: Exactly one of feed_id or category_id.

FilterWrite.description: Omitted booleans/order_id keep their current value on PUT and default to false/0 on POST.

text.description: Shortcut: matched as title and content.

limit.description: When > 0, also evaluate the filter against the caller's latest N stored entries.

FilterTestRequest.description: Provide text or entry (or only limit to test against stored entries).

WebhookOnSuccess.description: What to do with the entry after a successful delivery.

Webhook.description: The signing secret is write-only and never returned.

body_template.description: Go text/template; empty = default JSON payload.

WebhookWrite.description: On PUT, omitted fields keep their current value.

password.description: Subject to the password policy (length, common-password check).

MeUpdate.description: Change own password. Users authenticated via API token must still know the current password.

token.description: Shown once; store it - only its hash is kept.
